an3.87:2.5: This is the ordinary well-practicing mendicant.
an3.87:2.6: This is the first of three grades of stream-enterer, all of whom have abandoned substantialist view, doubt, and misapprehension of precepts and observances ([dn6:13.2](), [mn2:11.2](), [an3.94](), [snp2.1:10.1]()).
an3.87:2.7: The “one who goes from family to family” (_kolaṅkola_) and the “one-seeder” (_ekabījī_) are not further explained. Presumably they have stronger faculties.
an3.87:3.6: The _akaniṭṭha_ realm, perhaps so-named because everyone there is spiritually mature. This is the highest of the five Pure Abodes ([mn41:18-42.29]()).
an3.87:3.7: “With extra effort”: _sasaṅkhārika_. Even though their destiny is assured, still they practice further in their final life.
